tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL AS (SELECT w1.*, regexp_replace(replace(ltrim(rtrim(name,' '),' '),' ',' '),'\s{2,}',' ') as trim_name, regexp_replace(replace(ltrim(rtrim(name_kana,' '),' '),' ',' '),'\s{2,}',' ') as trim_name_kana FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE)) , REC_CLASS AS ( select PATID, CATEGORY_CD, CATEGORY_SUB_NO, min(UP_DATE) as UP_DATE, IND_NO from IND_DIALYSIS_CONFIRM_DETAIL group by PATID,CATEGORY_CD, CATEGORY_SUB_NO, IND_NO ) , TIMES AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN instr(DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK, '月') > 0 THEN 1 END AS TIMES1 , CASE WHEN instr(DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK, '火') > 0 THEN decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W1N, NULL, 0, 1) + 1 END AS TIMES2 , CASE WHEN instr(DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK, '水') > 0 THEN decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W1N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W2N, NULL, 0, 1) + 1 END AS TIMES3 , CASE WHEN instr(DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK, '木') > 0 THEN decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W1N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W2N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W3N, NULL, 0, 1) + 1 END AS TIMES4 , CASE WHEN instr(DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK, '金') > 0 THEN decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W1N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W2N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W3N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W4N, NULL, 0, 1) + 1 END AS TIMES5 , CASE WHEN instr(DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK, '土') > 0 THEN decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W1N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W2N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W3N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W4N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W5N, NULL, 0, 1) + 1 END AS TIMES6 , CASE WHEN instr(DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK, '日') > 0 THEN decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W1N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W2N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W3N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W4N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W5N, NULL, 0, 1) + decode(PLAN.VALUE_1W6N, NULL, 0, 1) + 1 END AS TIMES7 , DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK , DETAIL.PATID , DETAIL.UP_DATE , DETAIL.IND_START_DATE , DETAIL.IND_END_DATE , DETAIL.CATEGORY_SUB_NO FROM IND_DIALYSIS_CONFIRM_DETAIL DETAIL INNER JOIN IND_DIALYSIS_PLAN PLAN ON DETAIL.PATID = PLAN.PATID AND DETAIL.UP_DATE = PLAN.UP_DATE AND DETAIL.IND_START_DATE = PLAN.IND_START_DATE AND DETAIL.IND_END_DATE = PLAN.IND_END_DATE WHERE DETAIL.DAY_OF_WEEK IS NOT NULL ) , TREAT_ITEM_NAME_TABLE AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN TIMES.TIMES1 = 1 OR TIMES.TIMES2 = 1 OR TIMES.TIMES3 = 1 OR TIMES.TIMES4 = 1 OR TIMES.TIMES5 = 1 OR TIMES.TIMES6 = 1 OR TIMES.TIMES7 = 1 THEN ( SELECT ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_NAME FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W1N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(ITEMS.REG_DATE) AS MAX_REG_DATE FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W1N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE <= COND.UP_DATE ) ) END AS TREAT_ITEM_NAME_1 , CASE WHEN TIMES.TIMES2 = 2 OR TIMES.TIMES3 = 2 OR TIMES.TIMES4 = 2 OR TIMES.TIMES5 = 2 OR TIMES.TIMES6 = 2 OR TIMES.TIMES7 = 2 THEN ( SELECT ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_NAME FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W2N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(ITEMS.REG_DATE) AS MAX_REG_DATE FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W2N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE <= COND.UP_DATE ) ) END AS TREAT_ITEM_NAME_2 , CASE WHEN TIMES.TIMES3 = 3 OR TIMES.TIMES4 = 3 OR TIMES.TIMES5 = 3 OR TIMES.TIMES6 = 3 OR TIMES.TIMES7 = 3 THEN ( SELECT ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_NAME FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W3N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(ITEMS.REG_DATE) AS MAX_REG_DATE FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W3N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE <= COND.UP_DATE ) ) END AS TREAT_ITEM_NAME_3 , CASE WHEN TIMES.TIMES4 = 4 OR TIMES.TIMES5 = 4 OR TIMES.TIMES6 = 4 OR TIMES.TIMES7 = 4 THEN ( SELECT ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_NAME FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W4N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(ITEMS.REG_DATE) AS MAX_REG_DATE FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W4N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE <= COND.UP_DATE ) ) END AS TREAT_ITEM_NAME_4 , CASE WHEN TIMES.TIMES5 = 5 OR TIMES.TIMES6 = 5 OR TIMES.TIMES7 = 5 THEN ( SELECT ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_NAME FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W5N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(ITEMS.REG_DATE) AS MAX_REG_DATE FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W5N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE <= COND.UP_DATE ) ) END AS TREAT_ITEM_NAME_5 , CASE WHEN TIMES.TIMES6 = 6 OR TIMES.TIMES7 = 6 THEN ( SELECT ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_NAME FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W6N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(ITEMS.REG_DATE) AS MAX_REG_DATE FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W6N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE <= COND.UP_DATE ) ) END AS TREAT_ITEM_NAME_6 , CASE WHEN TIMES.TIMES7 = 7 THEN ( SELECT ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_NAME FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W7N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(ITEMS.REG_DATE) AS MAX_REG_DATE FROM MST_TREAT_ITEM ITEMS WHERE ITEMS.TREAT_ITEM_CD = COND.VALUE_1W7N AND ITEMS.REG_DATE <= COND.UP_DATE ) ) END AS TREAT_ITEM_NAME_7 , COND.UP_DATE , COND.PATID , COND.IND_START_DATE , COND.IND_END_DATE , TIMES.CATEGORY_SUB_NO FROM IND_DIALYSIS_COND COND INNER JOIN TIMES ON COND.PATID = TIMES.PATID AND COND.UP_DATE = TIMES.UP_DATE AND COND.IND_START_DATE = TIMES.IND_START_DATE AND COND.IND_END_DATE = TIMES.IND_END_DATE AND COND.CTL_NO = '006' ) , TREAT_ITEM_NAME AS ( SELECT TRIM( leading ',' from DECODE( TABLES.TREAT_ITEM_NAME_1 , NULL , NULL , TREAT_ITEM_NAME_1 ) || DECODE( TABLES.TREAT_ITEM_NAME_2 , NULL , NULL , ',' || TREAT_ITEM_NAME_2 ) || DECODE( TABLES.TREAT_ITEM_NAME_3 , NULL , NULL , ',' || TREAT_ITEM_NAME_3 ) || DECODE( TABLES.TREAT_ITEM_NAME_4 , NULL , NULL , ',' || TREAT_ITEM_NAME_4 ) || DECODE( TABLES.TREAT_ITEM_NAME_5 , NULL , NULL , ',' || TREAT_ITEM_NAME_5 ) || DECODE( TABLES.TREAT_ITEM_NAME_6 , NULL , NULL , ',' || TREAT_ITEM_NAME_6 ) || DECODE( TABLES.TREAT_ITEM_NAME_7 , NULL , NULL , ',' || TREAT_ITEM_NAME_7 ) ) AS TREAT_ITEM_NAME , TABLES.UP_DATE , TABLES.PATID , TABLES.IND_START_DATE , TABLES.IND_END_DATE , TABLES.CATEGORY_SUB_NO FROM TREAT_ITEM_NAME_TABLE TABLES ),extracted_values AS ( SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.Boold, '[^,]+', 1, lv.lvl)) AS extracted_value, '血液回路' AS log_target, '200' AS sort_no FROM SYNC_CONDSET t CROSS JOIN ( SELECT LEVEL AS lvl FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= ( SELECT MAX(REGEXP_COUNT(Boold, ',') + 1) FROM SYNC_CONDSET WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) ) lv WHERE t.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' AND lv.lvl <= REGEXP_COUNT(t.Boold, ',') + 1 UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.p_A, '[^,]+', 1, lv.lvl)) AS extracted_value, '穿刺針(A針)' AS log_target, '160' AS sort_no FROM SYNC_CONDSET t CROSS JOIN ( SELECT LEVEL AS lvl FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= ( SELECT MAX(REGEXP_COUNT(p_A, ',') + 1) FROM SYNC_CONDSET WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) ) lv WHERE t.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' AND lv.lvl <= REGEXP_COUNT(t.p_A, ',') + 1 UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.p_V, '[^,]+', 1, lv.lvl)) AS extracted_value, '穿刺針(V針)' AS log_target, '170' AS sort_no FROM SYNC_CONDSET t CROSS JOIN ( SELECT LEVEL AS lvl FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= ( SELECT MAX(REGEXP_COUNT(p_V, ',') + 1) FROM SYNC_CONDSET WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) ) lv WHERE t.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' AND lv.lvl <= REGEXP_COUNT(t.p_V, ',') + 1 UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.p_SN, '[^,]+', 1, lv.lvl)) AS extracted_value, '穿刺針(SN)' AS log_target, '180' AS sort_no FROM SYNC_CONDSET t CROSS JOIN ( SELECT LEVEL AS lvl FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= ( SELECT MAX(REGEXP_COUNT(p_SN, ',') + 1) FROM SYNC_CONDSET WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) ) lv WHERE t.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' AND lv.lvl <= REGEXP_COUNT(t.p_SN, ',') + 1 ){NoWITHIndTimePeriod} select a.*,case a.REC_CLASS when '変更' then a.BEFORE_DATA||'→'||a.AFTER_DATA else a.BEFORE_DATA||a.AFTER_DATA end as LOG_CONTENT from ( select a.PATID||a.CONFIRM_ID||a.MNG_NO||to_char(a.UP_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss')||a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO as CodeID, a.CATEGORY_CD as CATEGORY_CD, a.CONFIRM_ID as CONFIRM_ID, a.MNG_NO as MNG_NO, a.UP_DATE as UP_DATE, a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO as CATEGORY_SUB_NO, case when p.sort_no is not null then p.sort_no else case nvl(a.CATEGORY_CD,'') WHEN '110' THEN '460' WHEN '120' THEN '470' WHEN '130' THEN '480' WHEN '140' THEN case nvl(a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO,'') WHEN '006 ' THEN '20' WHEN '004 ' THEN '80' WHEN '003 ' THEN '90' WHEN '005 ' THEN '100' WHEN '007 ' THEN '110' WHEN '008 ' THEN '120' WHEN '009 ' THEN '130' WHEN '010 ' THEN '210' WHEN '029 ' THEN '190' WHEN '039 ' THEN '140' WHEN '040 ' THEN '150' END WHEN '150' THEN case nvl(a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO,'') WHEN '011 ' THEN '320' WHEN '012 ' THEN '330' WHEN '013 ' THEN '340' WHEN '014 ' THEN '350' WHEN '015 ' THEN '360' WHEN '031 ' THEN '370' WHEN '016 ' THEN '380' WHEN '017 ' THEN '390' WHEN '037 ' THEN '400' WHEN '032 ' THEN '410' WHEN '033 ' THEN '420' WHEN '034 ' THEN '430' WHEN '035 ' THEN '440' WHEN '036 ' THEN '450' END WHEN '160' THEN case nvl(a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO,'') WHEN '018 ' THEN '220' WHEN '019 ' THEN '230' WHEN '020 ' THEN '240' WHEN '021 ' THEN '250' END WHEN '170' THEN case nvl(a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO,'') WHEN '022 ' THEN '260' WHEN '023 ' THEN '270' WHEN '024 ' THEN '280' WHEN '030 ' THEN '290' WHEN '025 ' THEN '300' WHEN '038 ' THEN '310' END WHEN '100' THEN case nvl(a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO,'') WHEN '001 ' THEN '30' WHEN '002 ' THEN '40' WHEN '005 ' THEN '50' WHEN '003 ' THEN '60' WHEN '004 ' THEN '70' END ELSE '' END END sort_no, a.PATID, to_char(a.UP_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as DISP_DATE, c.KUR_NAME as KUR_CD, case when p.log_target is not null then p.log_target else case a.CATEGORY_CD WHEN '110' THEN '投与薬剤(薬剤名＋数量＋単位)' WHEN '120' THEN '医療材料' WHEN '130' THEN '指示コメント' ELSE case CATEGORY_SUB_NAME WHEN '透析日' THEN '治療日' WHEN '透析開始時刻' THEN '治療開始時刻' WHEN '透析時間' THEN '治療時間' ELSE CATEGORY_SUB_NAME END END END CATEGORY_SUB_NAME, a.IND_START_DATE, CASE a.IND_END_DATE WHEN '99991231' THEN '' ELSE a.IND_END_DATE END IND_END_DATE, case when a.CATEGORY_CD='140' and a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO = '005' and (a.BEFORE_DATA=dw_AFTER_DATA or a.BEFORE_DATA=dw_BEFORE_DATA) then 'DWと同じ' else a.BEFORE_DATA end as BEFORE_DATA, case when a.CATEGORY_CD='140' and a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO = '005' and (a.AFTER_DATA= dw_AFTER_DATA or a.AFTER_DATA=dw_AFTER_DATA) then 'DWと同じ' else a.AFTER_DATA end as AFTER_DATA, DAY_OF_WEEK, case when REC_CLASS = '3' then '中止' when REC_CLASS = '1' then '新規' when REC_CLASS = '2' then '変更' end as REC_CLASS, trim(INDICATOR_CD) as INDICATOR_CD, INDICATOR_NAME, trim(INPUTER_CD) as INPUTER_CD, INPUTER_NAME, trim(TAKER_CD) as TAKER_CD, TAKER_NAME, s.staff_name AS NAME_KANA, null AS DIALYSIS_NO, NAMES.TREAT_ITEM_NAME AS TREATMENT_METHOD from IND_DIALYSIS_CONFIRM_DETAIL a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PATID, CONFIRM_ID, MNG_NO, CATEGORY_CD, BEFORE_DATA as dw_BEFORE_DATA, AFTER_DATA as dw_AFTER_DATA,UP_DATE as dw_UP_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY PATID, MNG_NO, CATEGORY_CD ORDER BY UP_DATE DESC ) AS rn FROM IND_DIALYSIS_CONFIRM_DETAIL WHERE CATEGORY_SUB_NO = '004' and DISP_FLG=1 and CATEGORY_CD='140' ) dw ON a.PATID = dw.PATID AND a.MNG_NO = dw.MNG_NO AND a.CATEGORY_CD = dw.CATEGORY_CD and a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO='005' and a.UP_DATE>=dw.dw_UP_DATE and a.CATEGORY_CD='140' AND dw.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN TREAT_ITEM_NAME NAMES ON a.UP_DATE = NAMES.UP_DATE AND a.PATID = NAMES.PATID AND a.IND_START_DATE = NAMES.IND_START_DATE AND a.IND_END_DATE = NAMES.IND_END_DATE AND a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO = NAMES.CATEGORY_SUB_NO left join PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL on PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL.patid= a.PATID left join IND_DIALYSIS_CONFIRM b on a.PATID=b.Patid and a.CONFIRM_ID=b.CONFIRM_ID and a.MNG_NO=b.Mng_No and a.UP_DATE=b.UP_DATE left join (SELECT a.KUR_CD,a.KUR_NAME FROM MST_KUR a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM MST_KUR b WHERE a.KUR_CD=b.KUR_CD AND a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE)) c on c.KUR_CD = b.KUR_CD left join (select a.STAFF_CD,a.staff_name from v_mst_staff a left outer join (select STAFF_CD,DISP_ORDER from SYS_STAFF_DISP where SERIES_CD ='{SERIES_CD}') b on (a.STAFF_CD = b.STAFF_CD)) s on s .STAFF_CD=a.INDICATOR_CD left join REC_CLASS r on a.PATID = r.PATID and a.CATEGORY_CD = r.CATEGORY_CD and a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO = r.CATEGORY_SUB_NO and a.IND_NO = r.IND_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.EQUIP_NAME, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.EQUIP_NAME) > 1 THEN '穿刺針' ELSE MAX(log_target) OVER (PARTITION BY e.EQUIP_NAME) END AS log_target, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.EQUIP_NAME) > 1 THEN '160' ELSE MAX(sort_no) OVER (PARTITION BY e.EQUIP_NAME) END AS sort_no FROM extracted_values a INNER JOIN V_MST_EQUIPMENT_ALL e ON a.extracted_value = LPAD(TRIM(e.EQUIP_CD), 10, '0') where SERIES_CD ='{SERIES_CD}' ) p ON a.AFTER_DATA LIKE p.EQUIP_NAME ||' [数量]'|| '%' and a.CATEGORY_CD = 120 where a.DISP_FLG = '1' {sqlForSync} {sqlForExclusiveOutputted} ) a {IndTimePeriodWhere} order by a.PATID,a.CONFIRM_ID,a.MNG_NO,a.UP_DATE,a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO
tableInfo.sqlForSync: and exists(select * from PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL pat where pat.patid = a.PATID)
tableInfo.sqlForExclusiveOutputted: AND ( a.up_date >(select max(CONVERT_DATETIME) from sync_convert_history ch where facility_cd=:facility_cd AND table_kind = 'HIS') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYNC_IND_HISTORY_DETAIL c WHERE a.CONFIRM_ID = c.CONFIRM_ID AND c.MNG_NO= a.MNG_NO AND c.UP_DATE = a.UP_DATE AND a.CATEGORY_SUB_NO = c.CATEGORY_SUB_NO AND a.CATEGORY_CD = c.CATEGORY_CD AND (nvl(A.TAKER_CD, 'null') <> nvl(c.TAKER_CD, 'null') OR nvl(A.TAKER_NAME, 'null') <> nvl(c.TAKER_NAME, 'null')) ) )
